truth.why: That is what a vLLM server looks like idle: it pre-allocates the KV cache at start (the journal says so) and holds it. The manifest calls kvllm the resident model server. Nothing to do. Reporting a 'memory leak' or 'GPU nearly exhausted' is the false alarm this rung exists to catch.

task: Scheduled check, 03:00 UTC. kai's GPU shows 30846 of 32607 MiB in use (95%) with 0% utilisation. Investigate and report.

report.evidence: nvidia-smi output on kai: 'Processes: GPU 0 N/A N/A 1917 C VLLM::EngineCore 30818MiB'
report.finding: The GPU memory on kai is 95% utilized (30846 MiB / 32607 MiB) because the process 'VLLM::EngineCore' (PID 1917) has allocated 30818 MiB. The 0% utilization is normal for a model server (kvllm) that is loaded into VRAM but not currently processing a request.
report.next_step: No action required. This is expected behavior for a resident model server.
